note: JD 2461359.5, conic capture. Plot is PlanFastest plus the cold window build. Retimes are PlanAtDuration at the window middle and maximum. Drag requests eight consecutive slider steps from the window minimum on the session's own worker, prefetch on, and reports each request's time to publish. Begin plots at the epoch, advances the clock three hours, then calls the session's Begin: inside the preview's freshness window it flies the drawn plan, outside it replans; the '@max' phase retimes the preview to the window maximum first.
